name: oods-button
title: OODS Foundry Button
description: React adapter for OODS Button on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Danger/destructive uses solid bg-destructive and text-background, including hover and dark, to preserve text contrast with the team’s tokens. Primary preserves the team’s primary/primary-foreground token pair. Success and warning intents use the secondary variant; shadcn has no distinct success/warning palettes.
